messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync 1: legal signed off on deprecating the v1 SDK header (X-Redwood-SDK-Version). We need: 1) migration guide note, 2) updated SDK snippets for TS/Go/Ruby showing v2 body+auth, 3) redirects for old examples that reference v1 endpoints. Opened tracking PRs: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2501 (migration guide) and https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2503 (snippet updates).

Jordan Lee: Thanks. I'll take TS and Go snippets. Plan: show v2 fetch/axios + Go net/http minimal example. Keep a one-line "legacy" call in a collapsed note with header example so customers can see the mapping.

Omar V: I'll handle Ruby and add a short note about model aliasing when users migrate (some customers relied on rw-legacy aliases). Also: can we add an explicit callout about embeddings dimension change for a subset of models? That caused a few support tickets.

Tessa Park: Agreed on the embeddings note. I'll draft the paragraph that explains the vector dim change and a small migration checklist (check embedding dims, update index schema, re-generate vectors). Will include a CLI command example for reindexing.

Maria Chen: Nice. Localization: en, fr, de, es, ja. i18n-bot will queue once strings are in the PR. i18n-bot: please watch PR #2501 and #2503 and create jobs when we post /strings-ready.

i18n-bot: will watch the PRs and create localization jobs on /strings-ready. Please include context lines for translators.

Jordan Lee: Draft TS snippet (v2):
```
// TypeScript (v2)
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'rwft/gpt-3x', input: 'Summarize this article' })
})
```
Collapsed note (legacy): `// v1 used header X-Redwood-SDK-Version: 1`

I'll push updated Go example shortly.

Omar V: Ruby draft snippet (v2):
```
# Ruby
client.post('https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate', json: { model: 'rwft/gpt-3x', prompt: 'Hi' })
```
Legacy example note: `# To call v1 endpoints set header: { 'X-Redwood-SDK-Version' => '1' }`

Tessa Park: For the migration guide PR, I've added a short section "What changes in v2" covering: auth, model id formats, embedding dims, streaming differences, and recommended smoke tests. Also added a sample smoke test command: `scripts/docs-smoke.sh --migrate-checks`.

Maria Chen: Operational checklist to include in PRs: redirect entries for each removed page, smoke test run, l10n strings queued, snippet owner review, and a short note in the release changelog. Also ping support to update canned responses.

docs-bot: CI note: docs build passed for branch migration/migrate-v1-headers (job #1124). Please run `scripts/docs-smoke.sh` after redirects land.

Jordan Lee: I pushed Go snippet PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2507 (small change). Omar: can you quick-review Ruby? Tessa: can you sanity-check the migration checklist language?

Omar V: Reviewing now, leaving comments on error example wording. One question: do we include an example of graceful fallback to a quantized model for Dedicated customers? Might be better in Optimize guide.

Maria Chen: Keep fallback details in Optimize, but link to it from the migration guide. Also, add an FAQ bullet: "Will my existing keys stop working?" Answer: No, keys continue to work, but v1-only features will be deprecated on schedule.

Tessa Park: l10n prep: I'll add translator notes for the banner and the short migration headings; aiming to post /strings-ready by EOD.

Jordan Lee: Final action items: Jordan finish Go PR, Omar finish Ruby PR comments, Tessa finalize migration checklist and post /strings-ready, Maria merge banners and redirects once smoke tests pass.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. I'll post a short announcement in #announcements when redirects are scheduled and include the rollback plan. :thumbsup:
